adoption.method: Prefer recruit inventory for owned bodies and distinct observed IIDs; IIDs are namespaced by seed and leg. Origin=bought separates bought from created bodies. Legacy combat views have unknown origin and unavailable acquisition counts. Only captured acquisitions are observable; full roll offers are not logged, so no conditional buy rate is estimated.
adoption.retention_method: Same IID in the next consecutive own round's inventory, across any owned location; last observations, gaps and missing inventory are censored. This is body retention, including transformations.
